name: Audible
description: Audible is an online audiobook and podcast service owned by Amazon.

stock.note: Audible is a subsidiary of Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) and does not trade as a separate public stock.

marketing_spend.derivation: Estimated using a 10-15% marketing-to-revenue ratio standard for digital consumer subscription audio services, applied against estimated standalone business size within Amazon's subscription services segment.
